paragraphs: This company sells cloud software that governments use to handle transactions with the people they serve. The site presents that software under the Neumo name. The stated buyers are state and local agencies across North America, put at more than 4,500.

The product line runs from revenue compliance and court management through DMV services and integrated payments. Under revenue compliance sit tax and licensing, short-term rental compliance, auditing and unclaimed property. Public administration covers land records, vitals, records search and pension. A shared platform layer adds reporting and analytics, forms, digital processing, ID verification, eSignatures, alerts and managed IT.

The company puts its customer base at 4,500 across North America. It describes the result as higher compliance rates, more efficient staff, and services extended through kiosks and online payments. One published example describes the City of Santa Barbara applying its existing utility user tax to digital streaming services.

quote.text: Neumo provides software that powers transactions and interactions between government and the communities they serve.
